title: Getting to know the city of Granada from another point of view
text:
We did this route with a group of friends and it was one of the best experiences of our trip. 
Discovering Granada from a different perspective, combining its history and culture with a tasting of local food and wines, was a success. 
The guides were exceptional, providing curious data and anecdotes that made the tour even more special. 
Undoubtedly, an essential experience for those who want to know Granada in a unique way. 
Highly recommended!
